questions.stem: What is the highest common factor (HCF) of $24$ and $36$?
questions.explanation: $24 = 2^3 \times 3$ and $36 = 2^2 \times 3^2$. The HCF uses the lowest power of each common prime factor: $2^2 \times 3 = 12$.

questions.stem: What is the lowest common multiple (LCM) of $4$ and $6$?
questions.explanation: $4 = 2^2$ and $6 = 2 \times 3$. The LCM uses the highest power of each prime factor: $2^2 \times 3 = 12$.
